entries.translation: 捐赠化石将解锁其信息。

entries.translation: 点击背包中的化石即可捐赠！

entries.source: Not quite sure how to find fossils? This handy guide is just what you need!
entries.translation: 不太确定如何寻找化石？这本便捷指南正是你需要的！
entries.sampleRaw: §7Not quite sure how to find fossils? §7This handy guide is just what you §7need!

entries.source: When mining in the Glacite Tunnels, you will sometimes come across a Glacite Mineshaft.
entries.translation: 在冰川矿道中挖矿时，你有时会遇到冰川矿井。
entries.sampleRaw: §7When mining in the §bGlacite Tunnels§7, §7you will sometimes come across a §7§bGlacite Mineshaft§7.

entries.source: These mineshafts are the only place in which Fossils are naturally found, so jump right in!
entries.translation: 这些矿井是唯一能自然发现化石的地方，所以快进去吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §7These mineshafts are the only place §7in which §6Fossils §7are naturally found, §7so jump right in!

entries.source: When in a Glacite Mineshaft, you have a small chance to come across a Suspicious Scrap whenever you mine an ore.
entries.translation: 在冰川矿井中，每当你挖掘矿石时，都有小概率遇到可疑的碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: §7When in a §bGlacite Mineshaft§7, you have §7a small chance to come across a §7§9Suspicious Scrap §7whenever you mine §7an ore.

entries.source: Suspicious Scraps can contain a variety of treasures, including Fossils. However, you'll need to do some excavating!
entries.translation: 可疑的碎片中可能包含各种宝物，包括化石。不过，你需要进行一些挖掘！
entries.sampleRaw: §7§9Suspicious Scraps §7can contain a §7variety of treasures, including §7§6Fossils§7. However, you'll need to do §7some excavating!

entries.source: Once you've found a Suspicious Scrap, bring it to the Fossil Research Center!
entries.translation: 找到可疑的碎片后，把它带到化石研究中心！
entries.sampleRaw: §7Once you've found a §9Suspicious §9Scrap§7, bring it to the §6Fossil §6Research Center§7!

entries.source: The Fossil Excavator can be found in the Fossil Research Center, and can be used to find out what's hidden within your Suspicious Scrap.
entries.translation: 化石挖掘机位于化石研究中心，可用于查明你的可疑的碎片中隐藏着什么。
entries.sampleRaw: §7The §6Fossil Excavator §7can be found §7in the §6Fossil Research Center§7, and §7can be used to find out what's §7hidden within your §9Suspicious Scrap§7.

entries.source: Put your Suspicious Scrap and the Chisel you want to use in the excavator, and then press start!
entries.translation: 将你的可疑的碎片和你想使用的凿子放入挖掘机，然后按下开始！
entries.sampleRaw: §7Put your §9Suspicious Scrap §7and the §7§aChisel §7you want to use in the §7excavator, and then press start!

entries.source: When using the Fossil Excavator, you will have a limited number of clicks. Unearth as much treasure as possible before running out!
entries.translation: 使用化石挖掘机时，你的点击次数有限。在次数用完前尽可能多地挖出宝物！
entries.sampleRaw: §7When using the §6Fossil Excavator§7, you §7will have a limited number of §aclicks§7. §7Unearth as much §6treasure §7as §7possible before running out!

entries.source: After obtaining a Fossil from the excavator, you can donate it to Dr. Stone, who will reward you with HOTM XP and Mining XP.
entries.translation: 从挖掘机获得化石后，你可以将其捐赠给 Dr. Stone，他会奖励你 HOTM 经验和挖矿经验。
entries.sampleRaw: §7After obtaining a §6Fossil §7from the §7excavator, you can donate it to Dr. §7Stone§7, who will reward you with §5HOTM §5XP §7and §3Mining XP§7.

entries.source: After donating a Fossil, you will also unlock a new Dwarven Forge Recipe allowing you to turn that fossil into a new type of Pet next time you find it!
entries.translation: 捐赠化石后，你还会解锁一个新的矮人锻造配方，让你下次找到该化石时能将其转化为一种新类型的宠物！
